findings.summary: The chapter-three history snapshot was still missing the waterlogged satchel that current carries; con-002's stated fix had never actually landed.
findings.rationale: The satchel is restored to the chapter-three snapshot, so current now exactly matches the latest history snapshot. check_consistency now also enforces this current-vs-latest-snapshot equality (finding code current-history-drift) so the defect cannot silently recur.

findings.summary: The review that certified con-002 fixed claimed a fix that had not landed; the certification itself was correct in intent but not in fact.
findings.rationale: v01-c003-001 is preserved as the historical record of the first pass; this second pass records the actual state after the fix.
